thread:
Maya (AM): Starting ReliaWorks POC. They need SSO via SAML, SCIM bulk import (~500k users) with group->role mapping, and an on-prem production option. Also asked for pricing ranges and major blockers by Friday.
Sam (SE): Quick Qs: do they want full hourly deltas or near-real-time syncs? Also, what's acceptable cutover downtime for the initial import?
Luca (Eng): Recommend initial bulk import with chunking (2k-5k), concurrency 10, and exponential backoff for 429/503. For deltas, hourly diffs are fine unless they demand immediate enforcement — then use SAML assertions for session-time role enforcement.
Luca (Eng): Example curl for bulk upload:
```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Bulk -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @bulk.json
```
Nina (Infra): For on-prem air-gapped installs: we require a network diagram, expected RTO/RPO, and an approved SOW. If they want no management-plane access, support costs increase and we'll need signed SLAs.
Maya (AM): They estimated 150 TPS for auth checks during peak. How does that affect Dedicated sizing?
Sam (SE): 150 TPS sustained -> recommended Dedicated reserved capacity. I'll draft a pricing sketch: reserved + burst pool, and a Hosted-fallback SKU. If totally air-gapped, add a support uplift ~12-18% and a one-time deployment fee.
audit-bot: audit-bot: sec-pack delivered to customer link=https://redwood.example.com/sec/reliaworks-2026
Maya (AM): They sent a security questionnaire asking about SOC2, KMS control, log retention, and export controls. We should send SOC2 artifact and KMS options.
Nina (Infra): KMS options: customer-managed KMS supported in Private; air-gapped requires local HSM and audited key transfer. Legal needs to sign off on key escrow terms.
Luca (Eng): RBAC pattern: SCIM groups -> role mapping for bootstrap; use SAML attributes for runtime enforcement. We can emit webhooks for near-real-time updates but scale limits apply.
Maya (AM): Action items: (1) Maya collect network diagram + SAML metadata + QPS cert; (2) Luca prepare SCIM import recipe + backoff params; (3) Sam send preliminary pricing with Dedicated + Hosted fallback + air-gap uplift; (4) Nina confirm KMS/HSM checklist for legal. Sync Wed AM.
